title: Better Adventure Enhanced
description: This modpack adds a ton of useful and incredible content you wish it were on Minecraft. It's perfect to play alone or with friends, it gives life to the world with subtle details & big changes.
body:
Did you ever felt like Minecraft was a bit empty ? That Minecraft missed some important features ? That it is Repetitive ? Or too easy ? Then you are at the right place !

This project add new structures, mobs, effects, sounds, weappons, tools, items, ores, jobs, foods, decorations, biomes, trees, functionalities, particles, blocks, and much more to enhance the experience of the classic game while optimizating it ! [With create aeronautics and add-ons !]

This modpack also contain shaders and ressources packs, don't forget to load them before playing.

**Information**

You need to install the modpack on both serveur & client side to make it work. Most mods are customizable.

For any suggestions or to report bugs, go to my [Discord Serveur](https://discord.gg/JjZfVHQ8Zy). I will update this project sometimes.

The name "Better Adventure Enhanced", Logo and branding are reserved.

**Important**

All credits goes to actual owners of each mod/datapack/shader

This modpack includes many excellent mods created by talented developers.
Please support the original creators on Modrinth and their project pages.

_This license applies only to original files of the modpack (configs, scripts, documentation, custom assets). Included third-party mods remain property of their respective authors under their own licenses._

Original creation by [Scarlet Shadow](https://modrinth.com/user/Scarlet_Shadow). Any resemblance to another modpack is unintentional.

**Do NOT reupload this modpack** to other places like curseforge, it will be taken down.

Special thanks to the Minecraft modding community.
